statement: SpaceX has secured multibillion-dollar data center capacity leasing arrangements with Google and Anthropic, per reporting on its Q2 2026 results.
why: Pre-let capacity to large model developers is contracted demand that pulls GPU deployments forward rather than leaving them speculative.

impact.mechanism: Committed multibillion-dollar leases from frontier model developers give the operator revenue visibility to order accelerators and build capacity.

evidence.excerpt: the company has secured multibillion-dollar capacity leasing arrangements with Google and Anthropic for its data center infrastructure

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet, qualitative characterization with no contract terms disclosed.
